maria_cs: Quick heads-up — we're running an NPS + onboarding check for the Aurora preview next Wed (14:00 PT). Need someone to own outreach (final invite list + short survey). Who can take this?

devon_pm: I can own outreach. I'll send invites + spreadsheet. Need the list by EOD Monday.

raj_sales: I can pull account health tags + renewal risk flags for Aurora accounts. Do we include AE in the invite?

sam_support: include AE + onboarding lead. also have a short survey template here: https://bit.ly/rdw-nps-template

devon_pm: copying template, will trim to 3 Qs. draft Qs:
```
1. How satisfied are you with initial onboarding? (0-10)
2. Any blockers preventing you from shipping?
3. Would you recommend Redwood to a colleague? (Y/N + why)
```

maria_cs: perfect. @raj_sales add churn-risk tag column to the sheet and mark any accounts >7day stall.

raj_sales: done. added `churn_risk` column with values {low,medium,high}. Also flagged two accounts as high.

devon_pm: shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/abc123 (edit access for cs,ae,pm). will send invites Tue AM. planning 30m sync + 5min NPS pulse.

cs_bot: Reminder created: "Aurora onboarding NPS" on Wed 14:00 PT. Guests: 12. :calendar: 

maria_cs: Thanks team — can folks ack here once you get access to sheet? :thumbsup:

devon_pm: ack

raj_sales: ack

sam_support: ack
